name: facts_route_becomes_aggregate
expected: Canonical /facts spelling becomes aggregate spelling; existing grammar assertion fails. A public-consumer follow-up is facts_native_identity_consumer_and_observed_request.

name: actual_head_sha_replaced_with_base
expected: Python consumer observes head commit 111... instead of native 222... in data/observed and fails. This also supplies C19's explicitly reusable deterministic synthetic/base-identity falsifier, not live acceptance.

name: requested_parent_url_equality_removed
expected: The foreign-origin required /url fixture is accepted because other supplied links remain valid; expect_err for /url fails. Unused same_url is a warning, not a compile error under ordinary cargo test.

name: nullable_body_defaults_to_empty
expected: Omitted body is now present and null body becomes empty string; presence/null/unavailable knowledge assertions fail.

name: native_id_roundtrip_through_float
expected: 9007199254740993 rounds to 9007199254740992 while still serialized as a string; independent exact identity comparison fails, isolating precision rather than JSON type.

name: unknown_state_coerced_to_open
expected: Native future_native_state becomes open; external consumer exact state comparison fails.

name: production_emits_schema_major_two
expected: Actual Python consumer raises ValueError('unsupported schema major'); test rejects production output. Consumer remains unchanged and its additive-field positive control remains authoritative.

name: 304_overwrites_original_body_observation
expected: Second read body provenance becomes 304/2020 rather than retained 200/2019; equality of first and second upstream.body fails.

name: failed_revalidation_returns_stale_body
expected: IMPORTANT EXISTING-FENCE GAP: current test's changed 200 has no ETag, so it removes the cache before the final 403. This realistic fallback mutation may survive this test. Do not report RED without execution. A retained-validator 200 followed immediately by 403 is needed to make stale fallback reachable; inspect other existing cache contracts before adding any fence.

name: max_for_min_in_attempt_dimension
expected: Actual emitted effective maxAttempts differs from explicit minimum. S1 already has all-five min-to-max RED/restored evidence; this recipe is only needed if Main wants composite source-consumer mutation evidence rather than reusing that scalar-mechanism evidence.

name: cached_body_admission_skipped
expected: Cached exact read reports acceptedBodyBytes zero instead of cached native length, and cached plus-one cases can wrongly succeed. Both response and cumulative lower-limit branches are present.

name: representation_envelope_gets_unmetered_allowance
expected: Treating envelope/metadata as an extra unmetered allowance admits EXPECTED.len() bytes under EXPECTED.len()-1 cap. The private behavioral exact-byte fixture fails expect_err; this is not a source-text or compile-error fence. The public escaping test may still reject because its expansion exceeds the allowance, hence use exact private fence.

name: follow_authorized_pr_head_repository_link
expected: Valid distinct Other/Fork metadata triggers a second credentialed GET /repos/Other/Fork without repository authorization. Positive-control assertion requires exactly one request and fails. Wrong-link cases still fail validation first, so the decisive failure is the valid fork case.

name: status_policy_infers_rate_limit_from_prose
expected: Plain 403 fixture contains misleading 'expired rate limit not found' prose; mutant calls it SourceUnavailable/UpstreamRateLimited instead of PermissionDenied/UpstreamDenied.

name: raw_leak_compound_1_status_body_becomes_message
expected: Apply together with raw_leak_compound_2. Alone this should be masked by the independent public sanitizer and is not evidence of a missing fence.

name: raw_leak_compound_2_public_sanitizer_removed
expected: Apply together with raw_leak_compound_1. Returned error Debug contains actual token-secret provider body, so sentinel assertion fails while category/details remain intact. Unused sanitize is only a warning under ordinary cargo test. This compound mutation represents bypass of two independent sanitization layers, not a single-layer sensitivity claim.

name: recovery_continuation_rereads_source
expected: Large Facts first continuation becomes canonical pr://.../facts instead of artifact continuation, causing a second provider request. Independent request-count assertion fails before repeated pages can complete. Earlier shadowed continuation variable may produce a warning, not compilation failure.

name: recovery_drops_retained_tail
expected: Initial page remains intact but recovery artifact stores only first page. Later continuation cannot reconstruct JSON; tool-success or complete-JSON/body equality assertion fails, without new upstream requests.

name: tool_schema_omits_acquisition
expected: Serde input behavior remains intact, but actual tools/list lacks acquisition property; assertion on published schema fails.

name: catalog_omits_facts_grammar
expected: Actual pr:// catalog no longer contains facts; existing catalog assertion fails while real Facts read still succeeds.
